Rahu in the 4th from the Dasa Rasi afflicts the home base, land, and physical infrastructure with its characteristic significations of deception, poison, and subversive activity. In a mundane application, this points to chemical or environmental hazards and organised criminal or terrorist threats to the nation's infrastructure.
positional_conflicts_detail.rule_b_full_text: Rahu placed in the 4th house (Sukha Bhava — house of mother, home, and happiness) produces mostly adverse outcomes. Foolishness — intellectual dullness or poor judgment in domestic matters. The native causes sorrow to others — an unusual description suggesting the native's actions or personality create distress in those around them. Friends are present — one of the few positive notes. Short-lived — reduced lifespan. Happy at times — only occasional happiness rather than sustained contentment. Rahu in the 4th disrupts the house of domestic happiness and emotional security, producing a native whose own foolishness and sorrowful influence prevent sustained domestic contentment.
